text: I'm really sorry to bother you, I'm not sure if this is serious or not. I'm minding my niece, she's 2. Temp is 37.8. She's got a sticky pink eye which I think is just conjunctivitis, but I'm more worried because she feels cold, her hands and feet are freezing and she's shivering a lot even under a blanket. She has dark skin so it's hard to see anything, but I checked the palms of her hands and the soles of her feet and I think there are some small dark red-purple dots there, and maybe a couple inside her lower eyelid when I pulled it down gently. I pressed a glass on her foot and I don't think they faded, they looked the same through it. Her neck seems fine, she was looking down at her toes when I checked them. Sorry, I just don't know if I'm overreacting.
